title: 第27章 身怀气运之人
novel_title: 修仙回来后我儿孙满堂了
content_zh:
那人看到自己被郁凡发现，尴尬的笑了笑。

    随即便用锃亮的眼神盯着郁凡。

    “请问，您是武林高手吗？”

    郁凡：......

    “小伙子，没事少看点电视和小说，多看书好好学习。”说罢，郁凡便准备走。

    “我看到了！”

    那人激动的说：“我看到你用馄饨打中了那人的腿，所以他才被抓住的。”

    郁凡抽了抽嘴角，“你看错了，小伙子，你可能还没睡醒吧？”

    “不是，我是真的看到了！”吴若白很是激动，他从小就有武侠梦，总觉得这个世界上必定有着真正的武林高手存在。

    只是他没有找到而已。

    今天不过是如同往常一样在这家馄饨店吃早餐，没想到就看到一个气质非常独特的人走了进来。

    于是他一直偷偷的观察着他，当然他观察的也是很隐蔽的。

    就是自己在吃早餐的间隙偶尔抬抬头看看。

    这一看就看到了一个馄饨的行侠仗义，这简直就是他心目中的隐世高人啊！

    于是他厚着脸皮跟了过来。

    这也是郁凡没有注意到有人在观察自己的原因。

    虽然他对于别人的视线非常敏锐，可如今的社会，怎么说，风气不同以往，看到长得好看点的人总是忍不住瞅瞅。

    今天郁凡就深深体会到了这点，也不会再对于别人的打量有多大的反应了。

    吴若白激动的上前，直接跪了下去，“高人，请你收我为徒吧！”

    郁凡有些无语，当然他也不可能随意的收人为徒，当他的徒弟必定要有着自己的独特之处，和过人的资质。

    二者缺一不可。

    不是什么人都可以做他的徒弟的。

    郁凡抬手间，吴若白便感受到一道看不见的力扶起了他。

    好厉害！都修炼出内力来了。

    “起来吧，我不收徒。”

    吴若白有些失望，“是不是我的资质太差了？所以高人才不想收我为徒。”

    “倒也不至于，我不是你想象中的高手，也暂时没有收徒弟的想法。”

    吴若白眼睛一亮，“只是暂时没有！那说明以后可能也会收徒是吗？”

    郁凡一哽，以后的事情谁说的准？

    他自己也能感觉到以后可能会有不可估量的变化。

    所以也不敢说的那么绝对。

    但，这人......

    郁凡将灵力集中在眼睛上，眼睛渐渐的泛起银色的光芒，眼珠也呈透明状。

    居然身怀气运，有点意思......
content_en:
When the man saw that he was discovered by Yu Fan, he smiled awkwardly.

Then he stared at Yu Fan with bright eyes.

"Excuse me, are you a martial arts master?"

Yu Fan:......

"Young man, if you have nothing to do, watch less TV and novels, read more and study hard." After saying that, Yu Fan was ready to leave.

"I saw it!"

The man said excitedly: "I saw you hit that man's leg with a wonton, so he was caught."

Yu Fan twitched the corner of his mouth, "You are wrong, young man, maybe you haven't woken up yet, right?"

"No, I really saw it!" Wu Ruobai was very excited. He had a martial arts dream since he was a child and always felt that there must be a real martial arts master in this world.

It's just that he didn't find it.

Today I was just having breakfast at this wonton shop as usual. Unexpectedly, I saw a person with a very unique temperament walk in.

So he kept observing him secretly. Of course, his observation was also very covert.

I just looked up occasionally while eating breakfast.

At this glance, he saw a wonton being a chivalrous and righteous person. This was simply the hidden master in his mind!

So he shamelessly followed.

This was also the reason why Yu Fan didn't notice anyone observing him.

Although he has a very keen eye for other people, in today's society, what should I say, the atmosphere is different from the past, and I can't help but take a look at people who are good-looking.

Yu Fan realized this deeply today, and he no longer reacted much to other people's appraisals.

Wu Ruobai stepped forward excitedly and knelt down, "Master, please accept me as your disciple!"

Yu Fan was a little speechless. Of course, he couldn't just accept anyone as his disciple. To be his disciple, he must have his own uniqueness and extraordinary qualifications.

Both are indispensable.

Not just anyone can be his apprentice.

When Yu Fan raised his hand, Wu Ruobai felt an invisible force lifting him up.

So awesome!They have all cultivated their inner strength.

"Get up, I won't take any disciples."

Wu Ruobai was a little disappointed, "Are my qualifications too poor? That's why talented people don't want to accept me as their apprentice."

"That's not the case. I'm not the master you imagined, and I have no intention of accepting a disciple for the time being."

Wu Ruobai's eyes lit up, "It's just not yet! Does that mean you may also accept disciples in the future, right?"

Yu Fan choked up, who can say for sure what will happen next?

He himself can also feel that there may be immeasurable changes in the future.

So I dare not say it so absolutely.

But, this person...

Yu Fan focused his spiritual power on his eyes, which gradually glowed with silver and became transparent.

It's a bit interesting to be lucky...
title_en: Chapter 27 A person with good luck
